meta.description: Kickoff 45, the collapse taken apart. Part A: Kickoff 43's XOR_5 reuse circuit on five chains and XOR_5 without reuse on Kickoff 43's calibration chain, 6 cells, 5 interleaved copies, 10000 shots each. Part B, on every qubit at once: P0, P1, idle waits I1 (3.344 us) and I2 (10 us) in |1>, and one to three retirements K1 to K3, each run twice in mirror order, 4000 shots each. 44 circuits, counts.
